title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake on a cold wooden floor. Dust drifts through the lamplight of an old library. A desk, a bookshelf and a large painting stand nearby, and a heavy door with a four-digit keypad blocks the only way out. Find the clues and escape!
instructions: Type what you want to do: examine things, take items, use an item on something, move objects, or enter a four-digit code on a lock. Ask for a hint if you are stuck.

desk.description: A heavy oak writing desk with a green leather top. A single drawer is built into the front, fitted with a four-digit dial lock. Nothing else of note rests on it except a cold brass lamp.

bookshelf.description: A floor-to-ceiling oak bookshelf. Most spines are faded, but four red books have been shelved upside down, as if someone wanted them noticed.

red_books.description: You pull out the four red books. Inside the cover of each, in pencil, is a single digit. Left to right on the shelf they read 4, 1, 7, 3.

painting.move_text: You lift the crooked painting aside. Behind it a small steel safe is set into the plaster.
painting.description: A large oil painting of a lighthouse in a storm. In the bottom corner the signature reads 'R. Holt, 1926'. The frame hangs slightly crooked.

variants.text: The painting hangs away from the wall, revealing a small steel safe. The signature in the corner still reads 'R. Holt, 1926'.

drawer.locked_text: The drawer is locked with a four-digit dial. It will not budge.
drawer.unlock_text: The dial clicks into place and the drawer slides open. A small brass key lies inside.
drawer.description: A narrow desk drawer secured by a four-digit dial lock. It will not budge.

variants.text: The drawer is open. A small brass key lies inside.
The drawer is open and empty.

safe.locked_text: The safe has a keyhole and is locked. It needs a key.
safe.description: A small steel wall safe with a keyhole. It is locked.

variants.text: The safe is open. A folded card lies inside.
The safe is open and empty.

door.locked_text: The door is locked. It has a keypad that takes four digits and nothing else will open it.
door.unlock_text: The keypad beeps, the bolt slides back and the door swings open onto the cool night air. You have escaped the library!
door.description: A heavy oak door with a numeric keypad for four digits. It is firmly locked.

variants.text: The door stands open to the night air.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key with a tiny lighthouse engraved on the bow.

card.name: folded card
card.description: A cream card in neat handwriting: 'To leave this place, enter the year the lighthouse was painted.'

use_rules.text: The brass key turns with a click and the safe door swings open, revealing a folded card.

hints.text: Four of the books on the bookshelf look out of place. Examine them.
The numbers from the books might fit the lock on the desk drawer.
The painting hangs crooked. Perhaps something is behind it.
The key from the drawer must fit something on the wall.
Take what is inside the safe and read it.
The card refers to something you have already seen on the painting.
